responses.text: Greetings! {Slight Pause} Pardon my enthusiasm. I'm not accustomed to meeting so many new people, but I find you fascinating.
I've tried to learn as much as possible about the surface world since our community left our home.
{Dumbfounded} Why are the outlanders killing each other? Why do they treat us like machines?{Lamenting his fate} I wish we had remained in the safety, and sanity, of our Vault.
You? Did you re-direct the power stream back to our section?
{Almost incredulous} We thought nobody would ever manage to get past the radiation, and the ghouls!
We owe you our freedom, outlander. Please, if there's anything we can do for you...

topics.prompt: I was the one who turned off the vents at Vault 34.

responses.text: Yes, I believe that, outlander. We owe you our freedom.

topics.prompt: As I said, I saved you from being trapped down in Vault 34.

responses.text: Kindly! The leaders of this fine community have accepted us among them. They give us food and protection from the outside.
Some people here seem extremely unhappy. They keep talking about getting "shafted," "swindled," and "fucked."
Apparently somebody did them ill, all the way inside the surface-city with lights - the Strip, and Freeside, they call it.
We're lucky to be here, alive and well. The land's a mystery to us, but we'll find our place in it.
It fills me with hope to see that people from the surface world are kind, and brave. Again, thank you.

topics.prompt: I don't need anything in return for my help.

responses.text: Of course, please, take this! We carried as much useful technology as we could, before our journey into the surface world.

topics.prompt: I could use a Vault trinket.
